name: HomeToGo SE
summary: HomeToGo SE runs an online platform dedicated to holiday rentals, facilitating connections between travelers worldwide and available accommodations. The company conducts its business through a variety of brands, such as HomeToGo, Agriturismo.it, AMIVAC, Casamundo, CaseVacanza.it, EscapadaRural, Tripping.com, Wimdu, and Smoobu. Founded in 2014, HomeToGo SE has its headquarters in Luxembourg City, Luxembourg.
